text: On 2026-11-25 the Great Britain power system recorded a wind generation mean of 13145 MW, a minimum of 12200 MW and a maximum of 14620 MW. Compared with the previous seven days wind output was 58.8% higher. The day‑ahead wind forecast MAE was 1455 MW, well below the baseline MAE of 4909 MW. Demand averaged 35641 MW with a peak of 44466 MW and was 6.9% higher than the prior week. The demand forecast MAE was 757 MW versus a baseline of 2276 MW and the forecast MAPE was 2.19%. Electricity price averaged £202.2/MWh, ranging from £159.0/MWh to £253.5/MWh, and was 7.6% higher than the previous seven‑day average of £187.9/MWh. Data‑quality checks covered 29 series, with 25 passing, 2 warnings and 2 failures. Issues flagged were wind_onshore: FAIL, wind_offshore: FAIL, price_apx: WARN and price_n2ex: WARN.
